content: दैव {%a.%} (-वी|{%f.%}) [देवादागतः अण्] .²1 Relating to gods, caused by or coming from gods, divine, celestial; संस्कृतं नाम दैवी वागन्वाख्याता महर्षिभिः <ls>Kāv. 1. 33</ls>; दैवीनां मानुषीणां च प्रतिहर्ता त्वमापदाम् <ls>R. 1. 60</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 235</ls>; <ls>Bg. 4. 25</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">9. 13</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">16. 3</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 75</ls>. .²2 Royal; दैवी वाग्यस्य नाभवत् <ls>Rāj. T. 5. 206</ls>. .²3 Depending on fate, fatal. .²4 Possessing the quality of सत्त्व. .{@-वः@} .²1 ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} विवाहः) One of the eight forms of marriage, that in which the daughter is given away at a sacrifice to the officiating priest; यज्ञस्य ऋत्विजे दैवः <ls>Y. 1. 59</ls> (for the eight forms of marriage see उद्वाह or <ls>Ms. 3. 21</ls>). .²2 A worshipper of god (देवभक्त); दैवान् सर्वे गुणवन्तो भवन्ति <ls>Mb. 12. 158. 35</ls>. .{@-वम्@} .²1 Fate, destiny, luck, fortune; पूर्वजन्मकृतं कर्म तद्दैवमिति कथ्यते <ls>H.</ls> दैवमविद्वांसः प्रमाणयन्ति <ls>Mu. 3</ls>; विना पुरुषकारेण दैवमत्र न सिध्यति ‘God helps those who help themselves’; दैवं निहत्य कुरु पौरुषमात्मशक्त्या <ls>Pt. 1. 361</ls>. (दैवात् by chance, luckily, accidentally.) .²2 A god, deity. .²3 A religious rite or offering, an oblation to gods; उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल कर्तव्यं दैवमाह्निकम् <ls>Rām. 1. 23. 2</ls>. .²4 A kind of Śrāddha ceremony. .²5 Parts of the hands sacred to the gods, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the tips of the fingers; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 2. 59</ls>. .²6 Royal duties; न तु केवलदैवेन प्रजाभावेन रेमिरे <ls>Mb. 1. 222. 10</ls>. .²7 A science of phenomena, unusuals (उत्पातs); <ls>Ch. Up. 7. 1. 2</ls>. .{@-वी@} .²1 A woman married according to the form of marriage called {%daiva%} <ab>q. v.</ab> above. .²2 {%a.%} Divine, super-human; दैवी संपद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता <ls>Bg. 16. 5</ls>. .²3 A division of medicine (the medical use of charms, prayers <ab>&c.</ab>).
